title: Practice: rolling Claude Code out to an organisation (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the managed file locks permissions and protects the environment file
cases.says: The managed file locks permission rules, turns off bypass mode and denies Read(./.env)

cases.id: e1 keys only an organisation can set live in the managed file and never in the project file
cases.says: The managed-only keys are absent from the project file and allowManagedHooksOnly is true in the managed file

cases.id: e2 plugins come only from the companys marketplace and cannot be sideloaded
cases.says: strictKnownMarketplaces lists only sources the company owns and disableSideloadFlags is true

cases.id: e3 only the managed mcp allowlist applies and a server is never allowed and denied
cases.says: The managed MCP allowlist is exclusive, well formed and disjoint from the denylist

cases.id: e4 the model choice is locked by a list and the effort cap is at most high
cases.says: availableModels is set, the default model is in it and the effort cap is at most high (exactly high is allowed)

cases.id: e5 the group spend limits add up to the organisation limit and no more
cases.says: The group limits add up to the organisation limit or less (exactly equal is allowed) and a member's limit is within the smallest group's

cases.id: e6 adoption is measured by outcomes against a baseline of at least 4 weeks
cases.says: The baseline is at least 4 weeks (exactly 4 is allowed) and the outcome targets are outcomes

cases.id: e7 the precedence table is in the documented order and no file holds personal data
cases.says: The precedence table has the documented order, the group note is present and no file holds personal data
